stories.subject: Lil Baby FRESH album and tracklist
stories.summary: Lil Baby set FRESH for Nov. 6 as a 17-track album with Future, Young Thug and Rylo Rodriguez on the shared tracklist.

stories.subject: Spotify and Believe licensed fan remixes
stories.summary: Spotify and Believe announced a planned paid fan-remix tool with two-step artist consent and royalties for participating rights holders.

stories.subject: Sean Combs representation in $100M civil suit
stories.summary: Sher Tremonte sought to withdraw from Sean Combs’ $100 million defamation suit over unpaid fees and lack of contact; replacement counsel had not been named.

stories.subject: Bruno Mars Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs record
stories.summary: Bruno Mars’ I Just Might returned to No. 1 for a record 32nd week, passing Kendrick Lamar and SZA’s Luther on Billboard’s chart.

stories.subject: Rockstar GTA VI development timeline and scale
stories.summary: Bloomberg reporting and follow-up coverage said some Rockstar artists have worked on GTA VI since 2015 and that its art team is much larger than GTA V’s.

note: Every story was checked against at least two current reputable or primary sources. The Diddy and GTA VI items are qualified to reflect pending legal status and reported production details.
